_comment: Documented divergences of the Go engine against the event_stream corpus. Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that starts reproducing the reference verdict is red (stale baseline); a listed case that never ran is red. Corpus regen v2 (engine 4.3.2 generated with the optional guard_agent module installed, Guard-Core/guard-core#151) pins 47 real envelopes across 38 non-empty cases, superseding the round-1 generation-environment artifact that pinned expected: [] for 34 bus-emitted scenarios: all 34 round-1 entries were stale against the real pins (the Go bus reproduces the reference envelopes for those cases) and were removed by the fail-closed policy. The three entries below are the only surviving divergences, all rendering-level: the envelope type, count and every other field match the reference pins.

cases.event_stream/evt_geo_lookup_failed_downl: the download-failure reason renders the Go error type ('*url.Error') where the reference pins the python exception class name ('RuntimeError'): event[0].reason got 'Failed to download IPInfo database: *url.Error' want 'Failed to download IPInfo database: RuntimeError'; every other field of the envelope matches the pin
cases.event_stream/evt_https_enforced_redirect: the https_enforced envelope's metadata.redirect_url carries the full request URL ('https://example.com/api') where the reference pins the scheme-swapped origin without the path ('https://example.com'); every other field of the envelope matches the pin
cases.event_stream/evt_redis_error_connection_: the redis_error reason embeds the Go dial error text ('dial tcp [::1]:59999: connect: connection refused') where the reference pins the redis-py exception rendering ('Error Multiple exceptions: [Errno 61] Connect call failed ...'); the driver-specific error string cannot be made byte-equal, every other field of the envelope matches the pin
